title: Prime Minister shares glimpses of conversations during his metro journey to SRCC and back
body_text:
Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi today shared a video capturing glimpses of conversations during his metro journey to the SRCC programme and back last evening.
In a post on X, the Prime Minister shared:
"Metro moments…
Conversations during last evening’s journey to SRCC and back."
Metro moments… Conversations during last evening’s journey to SRCC and back. pic.twitter.com/GHIuPqYAKI — Narendra Modi (@narendramodi) September 6, 2026
